title: KernelGPT: Enhanced Kernel Fuzzing via Large Language Models
problem: Kernel fuzzing effectiveness depends critically on syscall specifications that define the syntax and semantics of system calls, but generating these specifications is largely manual work, leaving large numbers of important syscalls uncovered and limiting automated kernel vulnerability discovery.
motivation: Operating system kernel bugs affect billions of devices globally, and the primary bottleneck for automated kernel fuzzing (e.g., via Syzkaller) is the incomplete coverage of syscall specifications that guide test generation.
method: KernelGPT uses large language models to automatically generate and repair syscall specifications for kernel fuzzing. The system prompts an LLM with kernel source code and documentation to synthesize syscall specifications in the format expected by the Syzkaller fuzzer, then uses an iterative refinement loop where fuzzing feedback is fed back to the LLM to repair invalid or incomplete specifications. This LLM-guided specification generation covers previously uncovered syscalls and improves the semantic validity of generated syscall sequences.
key_novelty: Using LLMs to automatically synthesize and iteratively repair syscall specifications from kernel source code, dramatically expanding coverage of syscalls available to a kernel fuzzer.
contributions: KernelGPT: LLM-based automatic generation of syscall specifications for kernel fuzzing
Iterative specification repair loop using fuzzing execution feedback as an oracle for the LLM
Expanded syscall coverage compared to existing manually written Syzkaller specifications
Discovery of new kernel bugs enabled by the increased syscall specification coverage

metrics.other: increased syscall specification coverage; new kernel bugs discovered (exact numbers not available from abstract)

limitations: LLM-generated specifications may contain semantic errors not caught by syntactic validation; quality depends on LLM training coverage of kernel internals.
primary_theme: LLM-assisted syscall specification generation for kernel fuzzing
